dct_creator_sm: Santana Quintero, Mario (Carleton University). ORCID: https://orcid.org/0000-0002-3836-9714
dct_description_sm: This is a dataset of information compiled for Courses CIVE3207 (ARCN4100), CIVE4601 (ARCN4200), or any other for undergraduate students of the Architectural Conservation and Sustainability Program (Engineers and architects) at Carleton University. This dataset will use to produce a Heritage Recording Dossier of this important Site.  The data includes 3D Scanning data, photographs with control points for photogrammetry, and 360 images. Includes Building 1 (Dominion Observatory), 8 and 9 of the Central Experimental Farm.
dct_title_s: Central Experimental Farm Building 1 (Dominion Observatory) (Includes Building 8 and 9)
